lines.intro: This is the Experiments tab of your forge. Four steps: a baseline, one change, the same questions again, then before and after.
lines.baseline: Run 1 is the shipped toolbox, seven tools: our baseline. Six of six right.
lines.pick: Pick: only 2 tools. The model now sees just find item and check stock.
lines.settings: Two tools switched on, instead of seven.
lines.run: Run the six questions again. It takes about a minute. Here it is sped up.
lines.result: Before and after. Four questions went from right to wrong: 2, 3, 4 and 6.
lines.tiles: Two of six right. The tokens fell by almost half: two definitions ride along on every call, instead of seven.
lines.table: Without the supplier, budget and request tools, the model reached for the two it had, and could not answer. Question 1 still works: it only needs check stock.
lines.next: Next: try another change, or set one by hand on the Anvil. After two or three knobs, go on to the Shield.
